causes.title: A scrape target is down
actions: open5gs is part of the network's observability: docker ps / docker logs for its container; the gate fails while it is down.
upf-slice-traffic is part of the network's observability: docker ps / docker logs for its container; the gate fails while it is down.

causes.title: N4/PFCP association between the SMF and a slice's UPF was lost

evidence.detail: heartbeat lost x1 {'URLLC': 1}; e.g. No Heartbeat from UPF [10.53.0.8]:8805
requests unanswered x82 {'URLLC': 5, 'eMBB': 38, 'mMTC': 39}; e.g. [57407] LOCAL  No Reponse. Give up! for step 1 type 1 peer [10.53.0.8]:8805
re-association failed x4 {'URLLC': 4}; e.g. Retry association with peer failed [10.53.0.8]:8805

actions: Check the slice's UPF container: docker ps --filter name=o5gs-upf; a restart shows as 'Remote PFCP restarted' at the SMF.
After a UPF restart confirm sessions were restored: sum by (snssai)(fivegs_smffunction_sm_sessionnbr) and the slice's ue_probe_reachable.
If the SMF was restarted, stop the UPFs first, restart the SMF, then start the UPFs - a UPF older than the SMF keeps stale PFCP state (docs/open5gs.md operating notes; deploy.sh does this).

causes.title: Radio-link failures: UEs registered but without a data path

evidence.ref: ue-entrypoint: unhealthy ... restarting this UE only
evidence.detail: 1 UE restart(s) by the supervisor, per slice {'URLLC': 1}

actions: Each affected UE is restarted by the UE supervisor within ~30 s (ran/ue-entrypoint.sh); if many are left broken, re-attach: scripts/open5gs/start_ues.sh.
Find what stopped the gNB heartbeats (2 s, UERANSIM): a FIFO cell dropping signalling, a starved UE container, or wall-clock steps; cell-congestion and cpu-saturation findings say which.
